## 🥚 Easter Eggs – Hidden Details

The TVA embeds subtle secrets throughout its repositories. Only the most observant Minutemen will discover them. Here are the known eggs hidden inside this project:

| Egg ID | Location | How to Trigger | Reward |
|--------|----------|----------------|--------|
| `EGG-001` | `README.md` line 1 | Hover over the **“Generated files”** title for exactly 3 seconds | A hidden `<!-- TVA inspection passed -->` comment appears in source view |
| `EGG-002` | `exercises/time-loop.md` | Open the file and type `MOBIUS.MOBIUS.MOBIUS` at the end | The text briefly glitches into a Loki variant’s name |
| `EGG-003` | `docs/pruning-guide.md` | Scroll to the very bottom and press `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+T` | A TemPad icon (⏳) animates in the corner for 5 seconds |
| `EGG-004` | `tests/unit/test_nexus.py` | Run test `test_variant_detection` with `--verbose` and watch stdout | The test output prints “All branches are safe – Praise the Time-Keepers” in green |
| `EGG-005` | `assets/tva-logo.svg` | Open the SVG in a browser and double‑click the center circle | The logo rotates 360° and reveals a hidden “Loki” inscription |
| `EGG-006` | `CHANGELOG.md` (if exists) | Look at the date of the first entry – it reads `1970-01-01` | That’s the TVA’s founding timestamp, not a mistake |
| `EGG-007` | `requirements.txt` | Add a blank line and type `# Yggdrasil` | The next `pip install` will show a rainbow progress bar (requires `rich` 13.0+) |
| `EGG-008` | Any commit message | Start your commit with `[SACRED]` | The commit gets a special “Timekeeper Approved” badge in the TVA dashboard |

**Find all eight and report to the Time Variance Authority for a free TemPad sticker (while multiversal supplies last).**
